newsitem.title: USA: FPA Medical won't proceed with share offer.
newsitem.headline: FPA Medical won't proceed with share offer.

text.p: FPA Medical Management Inc said Tuesday it will not proceed at this time with its planned common stock offering, but will consider financing alternatives.
On October 29, the company said it planned to register an offering of $100 million of common, including an undetermined portion to be sold by current shareholders.

The company said its decision to not proceed with a common stock offering at this time was based in part on market conditions. As a result of the company's decision, it added, stock will not be sold by existing security holders pursuant to granted registration rights as previously announced.

FPA Medical said the alternatives to be considered include private and public offerings of debt and equity-related securities, adding the company may access the capital markets in the future at a time it deems to be in the best interest of the company and its stockholders.

"With the company's recently increased credit facility, cash position and final terms of the Sterling transaction, we are very comfortable in exploring financing alternatives other than a public equity offering," it explained.
